specification.signal: one-session adjusted close-to-close log return at t
specification.exposures_and_weights: estimated from 120 return observations ending t-1
specification.entry: next session vendor daily-bar raw open; ideal fractional-dollar target fill
specification.exit: same entry session vendor daily-bar raw close; liquidate all positions
specification.neutrality: dollars, SPY beta; additional 3 residual-PC raw-return exposures for PCA model
specification.borrow_convention: entry short notional * assumed annual rate / 252, charged each trade day
specification.cash_interest_financing: omitted; gross and adjusted returns are compared to zero
